d: Elon Musk once emerged as one of Donald Trump's biggest political backers, spending hundreds of millions of dollars to support Republicans and embracing the MAGA movement. But after the Republicans' major defeat in the 2026 US midterms, Musk says he feels "pretty foolish" about his political spending and insists he is not MAGA. So, is Musk having a genuine change of heart, or is he distancing himself now that the political tide has turned?
